ck_activity_record_status_times.name: ck_activity_record_status_times
ck_activity_record_status_times.value:
(
        ("activity_record"."status" = 'DRAFT' and "activity_record"."submitted_at" is null and "activity_record"."reviewed_at" is null and "activity_record"."reviewed_by_member_id" is null)
        or ("activity_record"."status" = 'SUBMITTED' and "activity_record"."submitted_at" is not null and "activity_record"."reviewed_at" is null and "activity_record"."reviewed_by_member_id" is null)
        or ("activity_record"."status" in ('TEAM_APPROVED', 'APPROVED', 'REVISION_REQUESTED') and "activity_record"."submitted_at" is not null and "activity_record"."reviewed_at" is not null and "activity_record"."reviewed_by_member_id" is not null)
        or "activity_record"."status" = 'ARCHIVED'
      )

ck_activity_record_file_replaced.name: ck_activity_record_file_replaced
ck_activity_record_file_replaced.value: ("activity_record_file"."replaced_by_file_id" is null and "activity_record_file"."replaced_at" is null and "activity_record_file"."replaced_by_member_id" is null) or ("activity_record_file"."replaced_by_file_id" is not null and "activity_record_file"."replaced_at" is not null and "activity_record_file"."replaced_by_member_id" is not null)

ck_asset_history_statuses.name: ck_asset_history_statuses
ck_asset_history_statuses.value: ("asset_history"."previous_status" is null or "asset_history"."previous_status" in ('AVAILABLE', 'IN_USE', 'LOANED', 'REPAIR', 'LOST', 'DISPOSED')) and ("asset_history"."new_status" is null or "asset_history"."new_status" in ('AVAILABLE', 'IN_USE', 'LOANED', 'REPAIR', 'LOST', 'DISPOSED'))

ck_asset_item_owner_scope.name: ck_asset_item_owner_scope
ck_asset_item_owner_scope.value:
("asset_item"."owner_type" = 'CLUB' and "asset_item"."owner_member_id" is null and "asset_item"."external_owner_name" is null)
        or ("asset_item"."owner_type" = 'MEMBER' and "asset_item"."owner_member_id" is not null and "asset_item"."external_owner_name" is null)
        or ("asset_item"."owner_type" = 'EXTERNAL' and "asset_item"."owner_member_id" is null and "asset_item"."external_owner_name" is not null)

ck_internal_notice_scope_team.name: ck_internal_notice_scope_team
ck_internal_notice_scope_team.value: ("internal_notice"."target_scope" = 'ALL' and "internal_notice"."team_id" is null) or ("internal_notice"."target_scope" = 'TEAM' and "internal_notice"."team_id" is not null)

ck_internal_notice_publish_period.name: ck_internal_notice_publish_period
ck_internal_notice_publish_period.value: "internal_notice"."publish_start_at" is null or "internal_notice"."publish_end_at" is null or "internal_notice"."publish_start_at" <= "internal_notice"."publish_end_at"

ck_internal_notice_publish_state.name: ck_internal_notice_publish_state
ck_internal_notice_publish_state.value: "internal_notice"."status" in ('DRAFT', 'ARCHIVED') or ("internal_notice"."publish_start_at" is not null and "internal_notice"."published_by_member_id" is not null)
